|game_text=Mace's game text may not be canceled (except at Senate). During battle, Mace may fire one weapon twice. [[Boba Fett (V) (Virtual Block 2){{!}}Boba Fett]] may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4): the Players Committee card image, on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date; the image may be older). It prints word for word the text of [[Mace Windu (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5)]] (the original). It is listed as its own version (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The current text is [[Mace Windu (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013.
* '''Original''' ([[Mace Windu (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip [[:File:VB5-44E-Mace_Windu.png]] of the base card)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 5, slip 44EAI. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Mace’s game text may not be canceled (except at Senate). During battle, Mace may fire one weapon twice. Boba Fett may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition.” The Players Committee AI card image ([[:File:VB5-L-macewinduai-pre.gif]], numbered 44E) prints the same text. Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-44E-Mace_Windu.png]]) prints slip number “44E” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Mace Windu (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]]): rephrased: “Mace's game text may not be canceled (except at Senate) and he may fire one weapon twice per battle. Boba Fett may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition.” Shown for the AI printing on the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013), where the entry is labelled “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”<ref name="cl-1250_45ai-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>. No published AI image prints this text; the image on [[Mace Windu (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] is a CardMaker recreation. The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-macewinduai-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual5-Light">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/macewinduai.gif</code>; the Internet Archive capture of that folder's directory listing ([https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034659/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Virtual5-Light], 18 August 2019) gives every file the date 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34 (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock5-Light/large/macewinduai.gif</ref>: “Mace's game text may not be canceled (except at Senate). During battle, Mace may fire one weapon twice. Boba Fett may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 5 set mark) and prints the number “44E” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Mace Windu (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side p. 11), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=11, page 11. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Mace's game text may not be canceled (except at Senate). During battle, Mace may fire one weapon twice. Boba Fett may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-45-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number; it prints the errata mark “E” bottom right (the Master List has one slip for Mace Windu (V); it prints no separate AI slip).
